caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure wearing a wide-brimmed black hat, with a beard and mustache, and is clothed in a dark blue suit that has red accents along the edges and cuffs, as well as a red V-shaped neckline and blue shorts with some yellow details. His hands are visible, with one hand slightly open and the other closed, and his feet are wearing brown boots with colorful dots. To either side of the figure's legs are two calves facing forward; the calves have white bodies with black and brown patches and are accented with red and yellow decorative patterns along their backs. The three figures stand on a brown, irregularly-shaped base or platform. The background is plain and off-white, and there is handwritten text in the upper left and right corners.
title: Plate 30: Saint Isidore: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
